Junior Business Analyst
Corvid Health Partners | Hybrid (Raleigh, NC)

Job Summary
Corvid Health Partners is hiring a junior business analyst to support our revenue operations team. In this role you will turn claims and billing data into reports that managers use every week.

Key Responsibilities
1. Gather requirements from stakeholders in billing, finance, and clinical operations
2. Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Power BI
3. Write SQL to pull and reconcile claims data from the data warehouse
4. Document business processes and recommend improvements
5. Track project tasks in Jira and join weekly sprint planning

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or a related field
- 0 to 2 years of experience in an analyst role, including internships
- Working knowledge of SQL and Microsoft Excel
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau
- Familiarity with healthcare billing or HIPAA requirements
- Exposure to Agile or Scrum teams

What We Offer
- Health insurance, dental insurance, and a 401(k) match
- Tuition reimbursement

You will wear many hats in a dynamic environment. Salary is commensurate with experience.
